verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents a Directory of services that agents can access programmatically. Its hosted MCP server exposes a documented "find-sellers" tool so agents can discover sellers themselves. Sellers publish services with name, type, pricing and identity requirements, and Skyfire approves each listing before it goes live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that find-sellers or the Directory returns usable listings, documentation of the directory's schema, search and filter behavior, and evidence of an open, keyless discovery index outside Skyfire's authenticated MCP and API.
